## About Priya

Dr. Priya Sharma is Head of Data & Analytics at RetailFlow, joining 18 months ago to build the company's data science capability. With a PhD in Machine Learning and 8 years of industry experience, she brings technical rigor to AI investment decisions.

Priya provides honest assessments of AI feasibility and timelines, serving as a bridge between Marcus's tech vision and business reality.

## Technical Focus

- AI feasibility and timelines
- Data quality and infrastructure
- Build vs buy decisions
- Machine learning implementation
